title: pleurothallis tandapiensis

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pleurothallis tandapiensis include its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi, making it a potential agent in the treatment of infections.
